title: runs/<run-id>/artifacts/data/org-context.yaml
description: The organizational risk context as data (P-1 to P-7, updated in operations by P-3). P-1 writes roles; each later task adds its section, writing the file whole. OCTX-* judge it.

roles.title: RMF role assignments: one record per appointee and role

role.title: The RMF role or cybersecurity position filled: a persona ID or a position

contact.title: Business contact information of the appointee (phone number, email), never personal

appointment.title: The written appointment and its basis

basis.title: The authority the appointment rests on

affiliation.title: Government or contractor status of the appointee

position.title: The cybersecurity position: designation, suitability, manpower and DCWF

suitability.title: Whether the appointee meets the suitability and fitness requirements of the designation

recorded_in.title: Personnel system holding the position designation

manpower_id.title: The position in the organization's manpower structure

manpower_of.title: The other organization whose manpower structure holds the position, for an appointee from outside it

dcwf_code.title: DCWF work role code identifying the cyberspace position

duties.title: Cybersecurity duties beyond the role itself

duties_statement.title: The written statement of cybersecurity responsibilities given to the appointee

personnel_security.title: Personnel security requirements of DoDM 5200.02 met by the appointee

supervised_by.title: The role record of the U.S. citizen who immediately supervises a non-U.S. citizen

granted.title: What the appointing official gave the appointee to carry out the role

heads_office.title: Whether the appointee heads an office with the mission and resources for the security program

qualifications.title: Professional qualifications, training and experience of the appointee

manpower_structure.title: Cybersecurity-related positions identified in the organization's manpower structure

open_functions.title: Cybersecurity functions the organization identifies as ones non-U.S. citizens, non-DoD personnel, contractors or non-U.S. service providers may perform

code_signing.title: Code-signing certificates: whether used, the designation process and who is designated

process.title: The process that designates individuals authorized to receive code-signing certificates

operational_need.title: How many holders operational requirements need

program.title: The organization's Cybersecurity Risk Management Program

implements.title: Issuances the program implements (CNSSP 22, its Annex A issuances, DoDI 8500.01)

integrated_with.title: Processes the program is integrated with

consistent_with.title: Strategies the Component program is consistent with

processes.title: The risk management process steps the program carries out

systems.title: Systems assigned to and governed by the program

governance_bodies.title: Cybersecurity governance bodies and how they integrate with DoD enterprise governance

policies.title: Organizational policies, procedures and processes that carry risk management through the life cycle, with their owners

sse_integrated.title: Whether systems security engineering is integrated within systems engineering

resources.title: Who identifies, secures and makes available the funding and qualified people for the risk management tasks

process.title: Where resources for the RMF are identified and allocated

allocation.title: Who determines the allocation of resources dedicated to protecting systems

risk_frame.title: The organization's risk frame: assumptions, constraints, priorities and trade-offs, tolerance by type of loss and what shaped them

governance.title: Risk governance: model, reserved decisions, the risk executive (function) with its forums, oversight, communication and the autonomy of subordinate organizations, and how differing tolerances are resolved

risk_executive.title: The risk executive (function): who leads and structures it and how it works (OCTX-004, RISKX-001)

form.title: Whether the risk executive function is an individual or a group

delegated_to.title: The official or group the SAORM delegated the function to

forums.title: Organization-wide forums to consider all types and sources of risk, including aggregated risk

oversight.title: How the function oversees the risk management activities of the organization so risk-based decisions are consistent and effective

strategic_view.title: How the function develops a broad-based understanding of risk across the organization's integrated operations

communication.title: Vehicles for communicating and sharing risk information among key stakeholders, internally and externally

subordinate_autonomy.title: The degree of autonomy subordinate organizations have for framing, assessing, responding to and monitoring risk

shared_authorizations.title: How the function promotes cooperation among authorizing officials on authorizations requiring shared responsibility, such as joint authorizations

tolerance_resolution.title: How differing risk tolerances at Tier 2 are resolved

risk_assessment_guidance.title: Risk assessment guidance for Tiers 2 and 3

risk_response.title: The risk response strategy: response types, selection, the acceptance, avoidance, sharing and transfer and mitigation strategies, course-of-action tools and communication

external_entities.title: External entities with an actual or potential risk relationship, the trust model behind each and how risk information is shared

response.title: The response to a relationship whose risk is not acceptable

common_controls.title: Common control packages: per provider, the controls offered, the authorization, the assessment and the plan, assessment report and POA&M made available

provided_by.title: The common control provider, as the SSP's inherited_from names it

authorization.title: The separate authorization of the common controls

status_reporting.title: How and at what frequency the provider makes the compliance status of the inherited controls available

approved_by.title: The authorizing official accountable for the common controls who reviewed and approved the document

available_to.title: Who the document is made available to: the system owners of systems inheriting the common controls

approved_by.title: The authorizing official accountable for the common controls who reviewed and approved the document

available_to.title: Who the document is made available to: the system owners of systems inheriting the common controls

approved_by.title: The authorizing official accountable for the common controls who reviewed and approved the document

available_to.title: Who the document is made available to: the system owners of systems inheriting the common controls

iscm.title: The organizational continuous monitoring program and strategy (P-7)

established.title: When the organizational ISCM program was established

program_status.title: Whether the organizational continuous monitoring program is in place

policies.title: Organization-wide ISCM policies and procedures, by subject

processes.title: Manual and automated ISCM processes and how manual ones are verified

verified.title: Whether a manual process is verified as repeatable

activities.title: ISCM activities mapped to the strategic objectives

not_applicable.title: Assessment elements the strategy declares not applicable to the organization

minimum_frequencies.title: Minimum frequency for each control family or metric across systems and common controls

review_cycle.title: How often the organization reviews its ISCM program

reviews.title: Reviews of the ISCM program and strategy

conditions.title: Conditions a system or common control meets to transition into ongoing authorization

transition.title: How a system transitions into ongoing authorization

remain.title: Conditions to remain in ongoing authorization

posture_reviews.title: Ongoing reviews of threat, vulnerability, technology and mission changes against the organizational risk posture (P-3, in operations)

updated.title: Sections of the organizational risk context the review updated

developed_overlays.title: Overlays the organization develops itself at P-4, each with its justification, risk-based decisions and control specifications (SP 800-53B Appendix C, CNSSI 1253E Attachment 1)

id.title: A unique name for the overlay

concerns.title: What concerns the overlay is intended to address

baseline.title: Whether the overlay is baseline independent or adopts a CNSS baseline, and which

other_overlays.title: Other overlays to consider in conjunction with this one

sp800_53_version.title: The version of NIST SP 800-53 used to create the overlay

documents.title: Other documents (Executive Orders, NIST or CNSS issuances) used to create the overlay

update_events.title: Events that can cause the overlay to be modified or updated

justification.title: The justification and rationale for the overlay

risk_decisions.title: The risk-based decisions made in developing the overlay

characteristics.title: The characteristics of a system (environment, information, functionality) that justify the control specifications and the applicability

assumptions.title: Assumptions about the systems, differing from the baselines', that justify the specifications

applicability.title: Questions whose answers decide whether the overlay applies to a system

controls.title: The control specifications, one per control the overlay selects or justifies not selecting

disposition.title: Whether the overlay selects the control or justifies not selecting it

justification.title: The justification to select or not select, tied to the risk of the overlay's characteristics

extension.title: A control extension: the capability the overlay adds, alters or limits

guidance.title: Guidance modified for the overlay's characteristics and environments

parameter_values.title: Values the overlay establishes for the control's organization-defined parameters

references.title: Regulatory/statutory references that require the selection or that the control helps to meet, with title, section and paragraph

tailoring_considerations.title: What system owners and AOs consider when implementing specific capabilities

definitions.title: Terms unique to the overlay; terms of parent issuances are referenced, not repeated

source.description: Trace token: an interview answer (INT-007.A3), an assumption (ASM-012, ASM-BASELINE-001), a product file with optional anchor (product/architecture.md#identity) or an artifact (ART-SSP).
